info.title: Cedar Device Web API
info.description: Implementation draft, revised 2026-09-12. See api-contract.md for state transitions, authorization, package framing, retry rules and business validation. This API is not implemented yet. Transport is HTTP on a trusted local network; TLS is out of scope for this version. In the first version the coprocessor is updated over UART only: method "ota" is present in the schema for forward compatibility but is rejected with 503 capability_unavailable, and esp32_ota reports available=false.

id.description: Opaque identity including root identity; not a fabric index alone.

ssid_base64.description: Exact SSID bytes, maximum 32 decoded bytes; empty only for unconfigured/disabled Wi-Fi.
Exact SSID bytes, maximum 32 decoded bytes; empty only for unconfigured/disabled Wi-Fi.

message.description: Maximum 512 UTF-8 bytes; escape/replace invalid bytes.

allowed_methods.description: Methods the server would accept for this image. A method listed here can still be unavailable at runtime; capabilities and coprocessor status are authoritative.

Upload.description: Staged firmware file. The image is stored as a file in the device LittleFS volume; filename is a display value only and is never used as a filesystem path. received_bytes is the next acceptable offset and advances only after the chunk is flushed to storage.

method.description: Installation method. Only "uart" is accepted in the first version; "ota" is reserved and rejected with 503 capability_unavailable until ESP-Hosted OTA is implemented. Check capabilities.features before offering a method.
